description: This file contains an in-memory implementation of the IProductRepository interface for managing Product objects during development and testing. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting products in a dictionary stored in memory.

classes.name: InMemoryProductRepository
classes.description: A class implementing an in-memory repository for Product objects, supporting CRUD operations.

methods.name: InMemoryProductRepository
methods.description: Constructor that seeds the repository with sample products to facilitate development and testing.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Adds a new product to the in-memory store.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a product from the store based on its Guid ID.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all products, ordered by name.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its Guid ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing product in the store; returns false if the product does not exist.
